package.description: Back up Windows drivers before a reinstall, diagnose Device Manager errors and install updates from official sources only.

en-US.description: Back up Windows drivers before a reinstall, diagnose Device Manager errors and install updates from official sources only.
en-US.longDescription:
Rain Driver creates a verified Driver Passport (a checksummed export of your third-party drivers) and a Rescue Bundle,
explains Device Manager problem codes, shows what changed on the PC and when, and installs drivers only from Windows Update
and the makers' own sources (Dell, HP, Lenovo, NVIDIA and official pages for other makers). A restore point and a copy of the
current drivers are made before any change. It never downloads from third-party driver-pack sites.
Free version included; optional Pro and Rain AI add-on. The builds are code-signed by Where2Go LTD.
en-US.name: Rain Driver
